''See also: [[Makiel Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Makiel, also known as [[The Hound|the Hound]], is the First [[Judge]] of the [[Abidan Court]] and the leader of the [[First Division]]. A highly skilled individual, Makiel was uniquely proficient in all seven disciplines, a feat unmatched by other [[Judges]] like Ozriel. Known for his intense focus on [[Fate]] and the management of destiny, Makiel possesses predictive abilities that rival those of the [[Reaper]]. He resides at [[Oversight]] on a planet located at the north pole, which serves as his home and lair. In combat, Makiel utilizes seamless white armor and a massive two-handed blade known as the [[Sword of Makiel]], which is characterized by veins of purple energy. He has also been involved in the development of prototype scythes intended to replicate the power of the [[Reaper’s Scythe|Reaper's Scythe]]. Makiel is a figure of significant [[Authority|authority]] and strict adherence to mandate, often clashing with Ozriel over leadership, duty, and the preservation of the [[Eledari Pact]]. His relationship with other [[Judges]] is marked by tension; he has actively sought to strip Ozriel of his rank and has been supported by [[Gadrael]], his loyal second-in-command. Following a defeat involving The [[Mad King|the Mad King]] that caused damage to his very existence, Makiel eventually retired from his position, leaving a vacancy in the mantle that could not be filled until [[Fate]] stabilized.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Makiel has dark, weathered skin and black hair streaked with silver. This being wears seamless white armor and white gauntlets, while his eyes blaze with a bright violet light. His presence is further manifested as eyes and an eye that floats over his shoulder.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Known as [[The Hound|the Hound]] or The [[Mad King|the Mad King]], Makiel is a [[Judge]] who focuses on the larger picture rather than mortal concerns. He can be cold when looking over others and has engaged in hostile meetings with Ozriel. His motivations include killing [[Daruman]] and Ozriel, as well as managing [[Fate]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Makiel is involved with [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]], whom he considers in his planning and keeps under close observation. He also has a hostile relationship with Ozriel, whom he accuses of violating the [[Eledari Pact]] and intends to kill. Additionally, Makiel is one of several entities that helped erase [[Daruman]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A skilled user of all seven disciplines, Makiel can create planets and manipulate [[Way|the Way]] to enforce natural laws. He manages [[Fate]] by tracing threads of causality and watching futures, and he can produce ghostly projections of his massive two-handed [[sword]]. Additionally, he created the [[Oversight]] system by [[binding]] void fragments with his will and possesses restoration skills.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Management of Fate}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The restoration of Makiel is a necessity, as [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]] is unable to leave her [[Iteration]] until this occurs. Without Makiel's presence, no two [[Judges]] possess the capability to fight The [[Mad King|the Mad King]], who plans to isolate [[Sector Eleven]] before delivering a killing blow.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c3">''Reaper'', chapter 3</ref> In her role managing [[Fate]], Makiel is able to watch various futures and trace the threads of causality. This power allows her to scan the future and determine when a specific course of action is acceptable.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c15">''Reaper'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c22">''Reaper'', chapter 22</ref> Makiel has previously urged for the execution of [[Ozmanthus Arelius|Ozmanthus]] and acknowledged the utility of Ozriel's [[The Scythe|Scythe]]. Despite being a [[Judge]] capable of matching Ozriel in open combat, their meetings have become openly hostile.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13">''Reaper'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c25">''Reaper'', chapter 25</ref> She has been known to look over others with a cold gaze while demanding their surrender.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c15" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As [[The Hound|the Hound]] and leader of the [[First Division]], Makiel served as a [[Judge]] who possessed mastery over all seven disciplines.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 4</ref> Following the need for the [[Court]] to find a new Makiel, the former leader named a successor.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref> Makiel later leveled accusations against Ozriel for violating the [[Eledari Pact]] and committing dereliction of duty.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 14</ref>}}
